description: Na₂CeO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three CeO₆ octahedra, edges with four CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four CeO₆ octahedra, edges with four CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-15°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.75 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six CeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-15°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.55 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with five CeO₆ octahedra, edges with four CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-12°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.65 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four CeO₆ octahedra, edges with four CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.70 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.63 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four CeO₆ octahedra, edges with four CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-10°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.72 Å. There are four inequivalent Ce sites. In the first Ce site, Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-11°. There are a spread of Ce-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.40 Å. In the second Ce site, Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-13°. There are a spread of Ce-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.38 Å. In the third Ce site, Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-10°. There are two shorter (2.26 Å) and four longer (2.28 Å) Ce-O bond lengths. In the fourth Ce site, Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-11°. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and four longer (2.29 Å) Ce-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ce atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Ce octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ONa₅Ce octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-12°. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and three Ce atoms to form ONa₃Ce₃ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ONa₅Ce octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-10°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-12°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₅Ce octahedra and edges with twelve ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ONa₅Ce octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-10°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°.
